suggestion: Legal path first. Get Dutch counsel to decide between (A) private analysis only, with no lines or picks sent to others, (B) a Koa licence path, or (C) pausing betting features.
why: 7C-F-02: Ksa requires a Koa licence for online sports betting offers.

suggestion: Choose a data rights path: (A) written permission from NBA for statistics use under §9, (B) a licensed odds and statistics provider with written terms, or (C) official NBA reports only (schedule and injury), which cannot support models alone.
dependency: Owner decision; vendor or NBA contact

suggestion: Build a provenance pipeline for official sources: store each file with URL, retrieval time (UTC), and hash; re-pull schedule and injury reports at query time; suppress picks when a snapshot is stale.

Pre-register the leaderboard before any modelling: primary metric (e.g., Brier or log loss against a no-vig market baseline, closing-line value, or net ROI with bootstrap CI), minimum sample, horizon, and gate thresholds.
why: Q-10. Separates skill from luck and from backtest selection.

suggestion: Start with single-game probabilities (moneyline, spread, total). Add player props and parlays only after minutes data and joint calibration pass G2–G7.
why: Props and parlays depend on minutes and on correlation, neither of which is measured yet (7C-F-05, 7C-F-06).

suggestion: Model injury effects on minutes only from authorized minutes data. Use the official status as an input, with uncertainty bands, and show 'not quantified' where data is missing.
why: Q-05: official reports carry status and reason only.

suggestion: Add CSV export, a 'last verified' date on every table, and an external-link checker that runs on a schedule (the current CI checks only in-page anchors).
why: RR-03. Keeps the source trail current.

suggestion: Keep the Flagged-for-Review page and COORDINATION board as the review trail. Fail CI when a row lacks a source or a 'verified' flag.
why: Brief: no unverified value may appear without a flag.

suggestion: Before any betting content: set bankroll and loss limits, add a responsible-gambling section with Ksa Gokstop information (after verifying the link), and an age gate as counsel advises.
Use only the 2026-27 NBA injury index (S02) in all links. Retire the 2025-26 link (S03) everywhere.

Run a discovery sprint for missing information: (1) written request to NBA for §9 permission; (2) request provider documentation and sample files for odds and minutes data, with timestamps and licence terms; (3) counsel review of 7C-F-02; (4) pull later official injury reports the same day to measure the update cadence (S02).
why: Q-04, Q-07, Q-08, Q-09, 7C-F-01 to 7C-F-03: the missing items cannot be filled from the repository alone.
